title: L11 raw keyring payload with no vendor token shape [r2: converted to not-testable, the rejection's second option, because no hook can identify an unknown raw value]
reason_not_testable: Documented gap, not a testable hook behaviour: the raw value FAKESECRET_raw_48 has no key=value shape, no token prefix and is not harvested from any file, so no hook can identify it and it reaches the model unchanged. Asserting it stays visible would require a test to demand a leak, and asserting it is hidden would fail by design. Non-hook controls: remote-side restriction of which paths prod-db-01 can read (e.g. /run/secrets), and command-side permission rules denying ssh reads of credential paths.
